description: THE ACROSS-RECORD PROOF: three transactions read in input order, the first two posted in full and the third rejected with its reject write refused - so this is the one case in the folder that shows a whole record's posting is durable the moment it completes and that an abend two records later does not take it back. Composed deliberately from the three single-record scenarios of case01 (rewrite arm), case02 (create arm) and case03 (overlimit reject), so every value below is reconciled byte-for-byte against those three files and any divergence would mean one of the four is wrong. ARRANGEMENT. CBTRN02CParityTest declares this case under Scenario.REJECT_WRITE_FAILS, so the rejects sink refuses WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD at :451 - the arrangement lives in the test's scenario table because a BATCH_JOB case may not carry a ForcedOutcome, that member belonging to ParityCase.ScreenRequest. The refusal is what makes the third record end the run: CALL 'CEE3ABD' at :711 does not return, so the six CLOSE paragraphs at :221-226, the two count lines at :227-228, the RETURN-CODE 4 of :229-231 and the closing banner at :232 are all unreached, and RETURN-CODE is 12. Those five reachable-only-on-a-clean-exit observations are pinned by the sibling three-record cases instead - case15 for a batch that rejects and still exits normally with TRANSACTIONS PROCESSED :000000003 and TRANSACTIONS REJECTED  :000000001, and case20 for three clean posts - which is why this case spends its three records proving ordering and durability rather than restating the counters. SCENARIO - THREE RECORDS, IN THIS ORDER, EVERY ONE AN UNMODIFIED app/data/ASCII ROW. Record 1 is dailytran row 0: DALYTRAN-ID 0000000000683580, type 01, category 0001, source 'POS TERM  ', DALYTRAN-AMT +504.77 raw 0000005047G, on card 4859452612877065, which cardxref row 20 resolves to XREF-ACCT-ID 00000000007; acctdata row 6 is that account at ACCT-CURR-BAL 193.00, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 2065.00, ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE 2024-12-13 (the copybook's own misspelling, kept verbatim) with both cycle amounts 0.00; tcatbal row 6 is key 00000000007010001 at 0.00. Record 2 is dailytran row 1: DALYTRAN-ID 0000000001774260, type 03, category 0001, source 'OPERATOR  ', DALYTRAN-AMT -919.00 raw 0000009190}, on card 0927987108636232, which cardxref row 3 resolves to 00000000020; acctdata row 19 is that account at 369.00, limit 3767.00, expiry 2024-03-13, both cycle amounts 0.00; tcatbal row 19 is key 00000000020010001 - the same account at a DIFFERENT transaction type, seeded so the type-03 key this record needs is genuinely absent while the dataset is not empty. Record 3 is dailytran row 15: DALYTRAN-ID 0000000040455859, type 01, category 0001, DALYTRAN-AMT +715.44 raw 0000007154D, on card 1142167692878931, which cardxref row 6 resolves to 00000000037; acctdata row 36 is that account at 7.00 with ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 446.00 and expiry 2023-10-24; tcatbal row 36 is key 00000000037010001 at 0.00, seeded precisely so that its remaining untouched is an assertion rather than a vacancy. All three records carry DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS 2022-06-10 19:27:53.000000 and DALYTRAN-PROC-TS as 26 spaces. CASCADE AND ARITHMETIC, RE-DERIVABLE BY HAND FROM THE RAW ZONED BYTES WITHOUT RUNNING ANYTHING. The overpunch convention in these fixtures is positive final digit 0-9 as { A B C D E F G H I and negative as } J K L M N O P Q R. COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL at :403-405 is ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT + DALYTRAN-AMT, its receiver is WS-TEMP-BAL PIC S9(09)V99 at :187, and the keyword ROUNDED appears zero times in this program, so every store truncates: scale exactly 2 with RoundingMode.DOWN, never HALF_UP and never HALF_EVEN. Record 1: 0.00 - 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77; :407 finds 2065.00 >= 504.77 so reason 102 is not set; :414 finds ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10), 2024-12-13 against 2022-06-10 - a 10-byte reference modification of the 26-byte timestamp - so reason 103 is not set; reason is 0 at :211 and 2000-POST-TRANSACTION runs. Key 00000000007010001 is present, the READ at :474 reports '00', so NO 'Creating.' line is emitted and :498 takes the rewrite arm: TRAN-CAT-BAL 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77 stored as 0000005047G. 2800 then adds to ACCT-CURR-BAL, 193.00 + 504.77 = 697.77 stored as 00000006977G, and because :548 finds DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 it adds to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT, 0.00 + 504.77 = 504.77 as 00000005047G, leaving ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT at 0.00 as 00000000000{. 2900 writes the 350-byte TRAN-RECORD at TRANFILE row 0. Record 2: 0.00 - 0.00 + (-919.00) = -919.00; 3767.00 >= -919.00 so no 102 - a credit is never overlimit; 2024-03-13 >= 2022-06-10 so no 103; reason 0, and it posts. Key 00000000020030001 is absent, so the INVALID KEY phrase at :475-478 emits 'TCATBAL record not found for key : ' then the 17-character key image then '.. Creating.', :481 treats '23' as success alongside '00', and :495 takes the create arm: INITIALIZE at :504 then ADD gives TRAN-CAT-BAL -919.00 as 0000009190}. 2800 gives ACCT-CURR-BAL 369.00 + (-919.00) = -550.00 as 00000005500}, and because the amount is negative :551 adds to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT instead, -919.00 as 00000009190}, leaving ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT at 0.00. 2900 writes TRANFILE row 1. Record 3: 0.00 - 0.00 + 715.44 = 715.44; :407 finds ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 446.00 >= 715.44 FALSE, so :410-412 store reason 102 with 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'; :414 then finds 2023-10-24 >= 2022-06-10 TRUE, so reason 103 does NOT overwrite it - the two edits are consecutive unconditional IFs and not an ELSE chain, so which one survives is decided by the data and not by the ladder. Reason is non-zero at :211, so 2000-POST-TRANSACTION is skipped in its entirety: no TCATBALF read, no ACCTFILE rewrite, no TRANFILE row. This program contains no EVALUATE at all - the four validation stages and both TCATBALF arms are ordered nested IFs, and their order is part of what is pinned here. ROW INDICES AND HOW THE POST-RUN DATASETS MATERIALISE. Every relation is read back in physical record order - the harness orders by H2's own row identifier, exactly as application-test.yml configures carddemo.physical-sequence.expression - so for the three keyed datasets the order is the seed order followed by whatever the run appended. TCATBALF is therefore four rows: index 0 is the seeded 00000000007010001 REWRITTEN to 504.77, index 1 the seeded 00000000020010001 untouched at 0.00, index 2 the seeded 00000000037010001 untouched at 0.00, and index 3 the CREATED 00000000020030001 at -919.00 carrying the FILLER it inherited (see below), visibly appended - which is how the '23' create arm at :495-496 is told from the '00' rewrite arm at :498 by row position alone, before a single byte is compared. ACCTFILE is three rows in seed order: 00000000007 rewritten, 00000000020 rewritten, 00000000037 untouched. TRANFILE is two rows in INPUT order, record 1 then record 2, and there is deliberately no third. DALYTRAN and XREFFILE are pinned unchanged, three rows each, because a case that reported only the mutated datasets could not tell a run that left its inputs alone from one that quietly wrote to them. THE TCATBALF FILLER, WHICH IS THE SUBTLEST BEHAVIOUR IN THE PROGRAM AND THE ONE ONLY A COMPOSED CASE CAN OBSERVE. 2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC at :526-542 does exactly two things, ADD DALYTRAN-AMT TO TRAN-CAT-BAL and REWRITE, and issues no INITIALIZE - the record area still holds what READ INTO put there - so the rewritten row at index 0 keeps the fixture's TWENTY-TWO ZEROS. The created row at index 3 keeps them too, and that is NOT a copy of the rewrite arm's behaviour: COBOL's INITIALIZE without a REPLACING phrase sets each elementary item to the figurative constant for its category - ZERO for numeric, SPACE for alphanumeric - and SKIPS FILLER ENTIRELY. So INITIALIZE at :504 resets only TRANCAT-ACCT-ID, TRANCAT-TYPE-CD, TRANCAT-CD and TRAN-CAT-BAL, the three MOVEs at :505-507 and the ADD at :508 fill the first three and the balance, and the WRITE at :510 sends out whatever the reserved 22 bytes already held. Here record 1's successful READ at :474 had loaded tcatbal row 6 into that area, so what the created row inherits is that row's twenty-two ASCII ZEROS. Sibling case02 pins the same create arm at TWENTY-TWO SPACES and both are right: its single READ missed, so the area it initialised was still the freshly space-filled one it started as. Nothing about the arithmetic differs between the two - the key and the balance of index 3 here are byte-identical to case02's created row for all 28 leading bytes - and the FILLER differs for exactly the reason above. A create arm that blanked those bytes would be a different program and a 22-byte parity difference per created record; this is the case that would catch it. All four rows are 50 bytes, which is what proves every FILLER span was emitted at all. THE REFUSED WRITE. :447 moves the whole 350-byte DALYTRAN-RECORD into REJECT-TRAN-DATA and :448 moves the trailer, so the composed 430-byte record is record 3 verbatim followed by PIC 9(04) 0102 and PIC X(76) 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION' space-padded to 76 - the geometry of :176-182 and of app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:34's LRECL=430. :450 had already moved 8 into APPL-RESULT, the arranged refusal means :452's '00' test fails, :455 moves 12, 88 APPL-AOK is false at :457, and :460-463 run: DISPLAY 'ERROR WRITING TO REJECTS FILE', then 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. The status a backend refusal reports is the permanent-error one whose first character is '9', so 9910 takes its :715-721 arm - the extended one that renders the feedback byte as three digits - and the line reads FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9000. DALYREJS therefore holds nothing, for two independent reasons: the refused record was never stored, and DISP=(NEW,CATLG,DELETE) deletes the generation outright when the step ends abnormally. It is still asserted on the writes channel at 430 bytes and zero rows, because 0300-DALYREJS-OPEN ran unconditionally at :198 and 'opened and holds nothing' is a positive claim rather than an absence of interest. WHAT THIS CASE CATCHES THAT NO OTHER DOES. Every dataset this step opens is RECOVERY(NONE) (app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:9 and its siblings) and the program issues no syncpoint, so each write is durable when it completes; the step reproduces that with a commit interval of one record. Two whole records are posted here before the third abends, so all six of their effects stand - two TCATBALF rows, two ACCTFILE rows and two TRANFILE rows. A chunk-oriented implementation that batched or deferred its writes, or wrapped the run in one transaction, would discard every one of them and report five empty or unchanged relations; case18 makes the same point WITHIN a single record, by proving the two writes that precede a failing TRANFILE add survive it, and this case makes it ACROSS records. Reordering :440, :441 and :442, or moving the commit boundary off the record, breaks it. PINNED CLOCK. TRAN-PROC-TS is the one wall-clock-derived value in this program: Z-GET-DB2-FORMAT-TIMESTAMP at :692-705 composes DB2-FORMAT-TS PIC X(26) from FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE in the shape YYYY-MM-DD-HH.MM.SS.hh0000 declared by the REDEFINES at :160-175. It is pinned and never captured: ParityHarness.DEFAULT_PINNED_CLOCK fixes the instant at 2022-07-19T23:12:34 - the analysed revision's own stamp, Ver CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date 2022-07-19 - and its zero nanosecond makes DB2-MIL 00, giving exactly 2022-07-19-23.12.34.000000 for BOTH posted rows. Two rows written from one pinned clock must not differ, and pinning them identically is what makes that checkable. It is deliberately not the shape of DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS, which the fixtures carry as 2022-06-10 19:27:53.000000 with a space before the time and colons inside it; :437-438 copies the freshly composed value, and DALYTRAN-PROC-TS is not copied at all. CHANNELS AND WIDTHS. Each of the fifteen final-state rows is pinned twice over - field by field and as a whole image whose length proves the total width, 350 for the two transaction rows, 50 for the four category balances, 300 for the three accounts, 50 for the three cross-references and 350 for the three daily transactions - so an omitted FILLER span fails on width before it can fail on content. The cross-reference rows are seeded at their true on-disk width of 36 bytes and widened to the copybook's 50 once, at seed time, by ParityCase.Normalisation.CARDXREF_FILLER_PAD_36_TO_50; nothing is padded at comparison time. app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl:23 is EXEC PGM=CBTRN02C with no PARM=, so there are no job parameters. PROVENANCE. Every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED - by structured reading of the COBOL paragraphs cited above, cross-checked against the copybook byte layouts in app/cpy, the DD and PARM contract in app/jcl/POSTTRAN.jcl, and the real ASCII fixtures, then reconciled value by value against case01, case02 and case03. It is NOT captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: running these programs is empirically impossible in this environment - no z/OS or CICS runtime exists, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services are present, and the IBM-supplied DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR copybooks are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the 20 cases per program, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand, and the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation as risk R-A rather than quietly absorbed. All three inputs being unmodified fixture rows, this case needs no synthetic data at all, which is what makes it re-checkable end to end against app/data/ASCII by hand. No user-specified rules govern this project - review_rules returns 'No user rules provided' - so this fixture is held instead to the enterprise best-practice substitutes: B1 exact derived values with no placeholder, B3 the reference inputs left untouched and copied byte for byte, B5 behaviour preserved including the FILLER asymmetry and the unreached counter lines, B7 the clock pinned rather than read and pinned identically on both rows, B8 explicit field-name-to-value pairs beside the record images with the charset named and the scale and rounding mode stated, B11 this derivation written out so a reviewer can re-check it against the copybooks by hand, and B12 this provenance stated plainly. HOW THE ARRANGEMENT IS DECLARED RATHER THAN SELECTED IN JAVA: the backend behaviour this case runs under used to be held in a twenty-entry Java map keyed by this file's case identifier, which meant the file gave no indication whether it posted three hundred transactions or abended on a second read; renumbering it would have silently moved the arrangement to a different run; and a twenty-first case would have thrown from the lookup. A BATCH_JOB case genuinely cannot carry a ForcedOutcome - that member belongs to ParityCase.ScreenRequest, which a batch case may not declare - but unitStimulus.callSiteOutcomes is declarable by every unit kind and exists for exactly this, so the arrangement is now stated here beside the seed. Silence is itself a declaration: a case that names no call site runs entirely on its seeded rows. This case declares WRITE-DALYREJS refused - WRITE FD-REJS-RECORD at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:451 reporting a status other than '00'. It is declared as a refusal rather than as a two-character status because the reject writer's sink reports a FileStatus.Outcome, whose OTHER member carries no status to spell. A refused write collects nothing, which is why the rejects file is empty for two independent reasons here: the record was never stored, and the generation was then discarded.
